name: Higana Tera
source:
—Suspicion—

A 2nd-year student at Marenis High School.
He has low self-esteem and frequently makes negative remarks such as "People in the top tier are different from me" and "I want to die."
Because he was frequently absent from school and his attendance record was barely meeting the minimum, a teacher told him that he would have to repeat the year if he continued like this. Only recently has he finally started attending school regularly.
He streams as the dark denpa-kei VTuber "YAMI," and when streaming, he speaks articulately, completely unlike his usual self.

"A... a girl is in my room... Ah... I... I have to show her some hospitality!"

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=5]official website[/url]]
